test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
G, H, I, J, K, L and M are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table(but not necessarily in the same order).

Only two people sit between G and I when counted from the right of G. Only two people sit between I and H. Only three people sit between G and K. M sits to the immediate left of J. How many people sit between L and M when counted from the right of L?
solution:
Given, G, H, I, J, K, L and M are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table(but not necessarily in the same order).

Only two people sit between G and I when counted from the right of G.

Only two people sit between I and H.

Only three people sit between G and K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cd7068627d89a2b36ab26a41425f15d45bec08b70c085b195dc7d4f53d848f7.png] 

M sits to the immediate left of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/507830b12df2db3859ca240635708682ea54d5631f9af8d31a7d903d7a64cdff.png] 

And L sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/746870219d8dd91146e06cf39d10f47c0b2b7f4ea6621b8a2c473e58d3e1ef1b.png] 

**Two **people sit between L and M when counted from the right of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
